PHOTO FILE - UNIT 7, 2-KARTA (raqamsiz bet, pdf 152). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 7'.

SURAT: Martina Hingis (qora sochli yosh tennischi, oq sport kiyimida) olomon oldida katta kumush kubokni boshi ustida ko'tarib jilmaymoqda.
Ko'k sarlavha 'Martina Hingis'.

TO'LDIRILADIGAN MATN:
'Martina Hingis is one of the greatest tennis players ......' (4 qator)
'Martina was born in Kosice, Czechoslovakia ......' (5 qator)
'In 1994 she became European Champion for players under 18. ......' (11 qator)
'Martina doesn't have a lot of time for a social life. She is determined and ......' (10 qator)

⚠ Bu 53-betdagi 28-mashq (mashhur sportchi profili yozish) uchun shablon. 27-mashq qaydlari: born 30th September 1980; started tennis at 3; parents divorced, mother remarried; moved to Switzerland; European Champion under 18 in 1994; Wimbledon doubles 1996 at 15; all four Grand Slam doubles titles 1998; determined, hardworking, keen on all sports; likes horse riding, skiing, art galleries, theatre, cinema; plans - keep horses.

modelAnswers:
Martina Hingis

Martina Hingis is one of the greatest tennis players in the history of women's tennis. She has won many important titles and everyone in the world of tennis has heard of her.

Martina was born in Kosice, Czechoslovakia, on 30th September, 1980. She started playing tennis at the age of three. Her parents divorced and her mother remarried. Martina moved to Switzerland with her mother and stepfather, and she has lived there ever since.

In 1994 she became European Champion for players under 18. In 1996, at the age of only 15, she won the Wimbledon doubles title. In 1998 she won all four Grand Slam doubles titles. She has been one of the top players in the world for many years.

Martina doesn't have a lot of time for a social life. She is determined and hardworking, and she is keen on all sports. In her free time she likes horse riding, skiing and going to art galleries, the theatre and the cinema. When she retires from tennis, she'd like to keep horses.
